questions.question: Ram Kumar bought two LED TV sets for Rs. 41,000. By selling one at a profit of 20% and the other at a loss of 15%, he found that the selling prices of both the TV sets are the same. Find his overall gain or loss.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ram Kumar bought two LED TV sets for Rs. 41,000, selling one at a profit of 20% and the other at a loss of 15%

**Calculations:**

Let the cost price of items be Rs. ‘x’ and Rs '41000-x’

He got 20% profit on Rs x & 15% loss on Rs ‘41000 - x’

Selling price (at profit) = x + 20% of x = 120% of x

Selling price (at loss) = 41000 - x - 15% of 41000 - x = 85% (41000 - x)

According to the question

120% of x = 85% (41000 - x) (selling price are the same)

⇒ 120x = 85 × (41000 - x)

⇒ 24x = 17 × (41000 - x)

⇒ 41x = 17 × 41000

⇒ x = 17000 and 41000 - x = 24000

Total selling price = 120% of x + 85%(41000 - x)

⇒ 120% of 17000 + 85% of 24000

⇒ 20400 + 20400

⇒ 40800

So,

Loss = Cost Price - Selling Price

⇒ 41000 - 40800

⇒ 200 Rupees

**∴ The correct choice is option 1.**

questions.question: Which is the fat-storing tissue in our body?

__
 
• **Adipose tissue**__

 
 
• It is the **fat-storing **tissue in our body.
 
• It is a central metabolic organ in the regulation of whole-body energy homeostasis.
 
• It helps to store energy in the form of fat, cushion internal organs, and insulate the body.
 
• There are three types of adipose tissue: white, brown, and beige adipose.
 
 
 
• **Areolar tissue**
 
 
• It is a connective tissue in which fibres are loosely arranged in a net or meshwork.
 
• The function includes the support and binding of other tissues.
 
• It also helps in defending against infection.
 
• When a body region is inflamed, the areolar tissue in the area soaks up the excess fluid like a sponge and the affected area swells and becomes puffy, a condition called Edema.
 
 
 
• **Epithelial tissue**
 
 
• They are the major tissue in glands.
 
• They form the covering of all body surfaces, line body cavities and hollow organs.
 
• The four major classes of simple epithelium are: simple squamous; simple cuboidal; simple columnar; and pseudostratified
 
 
 
• **Vascular tissue**
 
 
• It is the main transport system of plants.
 
• It is comprised of the xylem and the phloem.
 
• These two tissues transport fluid and nutrients internally.

questions.question: If a + b + c = 14, ab + bc + ca = 47 and abc = 15 then find the value of a³ + b³ +c³.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct algebraic shortcut: **a³ + b³ + c³ = S(S² − 3P) + 3Q**

Where **Sum (S)** = 14, **Sum of Products (P)** = 47, and **Product (Q)** = 15.

a³ + b³ + c³ = 14 × (14² − 3 × 47) + 3 × 15

a³ + b³ + c³ = 14 × (196 − 141) + 45 = 14 × 55 + 45 = 770 + 45 = 815

**∴ The correct answer is 815.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** a + b + c = 14, ab + bc + ca = 47, abc = 15

**Formula Used:** (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca) and a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − (ab + bc + ca))

⇒ (14)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(47)

⇒ 196 = a² + b² + c² + 94

⇒ a² + b² + c² = 196 − 94 = 102

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 3(15) = 14(102 − 47)

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 45 = 14(55)

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 45 = 770

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ = 770 + 45 = 815

**∴ The correct answer is 815.**

**__Additional Information__**

Special Case of Sum of Cubes

If a + b + c = 0, then the identity simplifies to a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.

Squared Differences Identity

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 1/2(a + b + c)[(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²].

Sum of Squares

a² + b² + c² = (a + b + c)² − 2(ab + bc + ca) is useful for finding squared terms when the sum and pair products are known.</p

questions.question: Driving his car at the speed of 30 km/h Vinod reaches his office 5 min late. If his speed is 40 km/h, he reaches the office 3 min early. Find the distance he travels between his residence and his office.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Driving his car at the speed of 30 km/h Vinod reaches his office 5 min late and at speed of 40 km/h, he reaches the office 3 min early.

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculations:**

Let the time be ‘t’ minutes to reach office

Let the distance be D.

Time for 30km/h

⇒ (t + 5)/60 = D/30 ----(1) (1 minute = 1/60 hours)

Time for 40 km/h

⇒ (t – 3)/60 = D/40 ----(2)

Subtract equation (2) from (1)

⇒ [t + 5 - (t - 3)]/60 = D/30 - D/40

⇒ (D/30) - (D/40) = 8/60

⇒ (4D - 3D)/120 = 8/60

⇒ D/120 = 8/60

⇒ D = 16 km

**∴ The correct choice is option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Difference in time = Distance/Speed

⇒ [5 - (-3)]/60 = D/30 – D/40 (8 minutes = 8/60 in hours)

⇒ 8/60 = D/30 – D/40 

⇒ D/120 = 8/60

**∴ D = 16 km**

questions.question: In an isosceles triangle ABC, if AB = AC = 26 cm and BC = 20 cm, find the area of triangle ABC.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Height of **isosceles triangle** = √(side² − (base/2)²)

Height = √(26² − 10²) = √(676 − 100) = √576 = **24 cm**

Area = 1/2 × Base × Height = 1/2 × 20 × 24 = **240 cm²**

**∴ The correct answer is 240 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **AB** = **AC** = 26 cm, **BC** = 20 cm

**Formula Used:** Area of Δ = 1/2 × base × height; In isosceles Δ, altitude to base bisects the base.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cbf53fe626053a54a91106169bf05cfe3faa353999dcc9742d79ed886863fd6.png] 

Let **AD** be the altitude from **A** to **BC**. ∴ **BD** = **DC** = 20/2 = 10 cm.

In right-angled Δ**ADC**, by **Pythagoras Theorem**:

⇒ AD² + DC² = AC²

⇒ h² + 10² = 26²

⇒ h² + 100 = 676

⇒ h² = 576

⇒ h = 24 cm

Area of ΔABC = 1/2 × BC × AD

⇒ Area = 1/2 × 20 × 24

⇒ Area = 10 × 24 = 240 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 240 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

For any triangle with sides a, b, c, Area = √(s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)) where s = (a+b+c)/2.

Isosceles Triangle Properties

Two sides are equal, and the angles opposite to the equal sides are also equal.

Pythagorean Triplet

The set (10, 24, 26) is a multiple of the (5, 12, 13) triplet, which simplifies height calculation.</p
